SaleNetAmount.description: Gross sales value before expenses. Total retail revenue amount. Use SUM(MrpValue).

net_sales.description: Total revenue collection. Maps directly to MrpValue.

turnover.description: Gross intake value. Maps directly to MrpValue.

revenue.description: Total financial intake. Maps directly to MrpValue.

quantity.description: Physical items or volume sold. Pieces moved. Use SUM(AppQty).

pcs.description: Count of individual product units. Maps directly to AppQty.

product_cost.description: Total investment spent to source items. Use SUM(CostValue).

unit_price.description: The sticker price tag on a single unit. Use AVG(ItemMRP) or ItemMRP.

profit.description: When profit/margin is asked without cost breakdown, use MrpValue minus CostValue in SQL.

salesperson.description: Retail store staff member. ALWAYS use dbo.VW_MB_POWERBI_SLS_DATA_WITHOUT_ITEMID with SalesPersonName dimension, SalesQuantity for units, SalesNetAmount for revenue, CashmemoDt for date. SupplierName is vendor/clothing brand — NOT a person.

staff.description: Store employee / sales rep. Use dbo.VW_MB_POWERBI_SLS_DATA_WITHOUT_ITEMID with SalesPersonName, SalesQuantity for units, SalesNetAmount for revenue, CashmemoDt for date.

store.description: Physical retail shop outlet location name.

location.description: Geographic retail placement indicator. Maps directly to BranchAlias.

date.description: The true calendar transaction execution date. Format is YYYY-MM-DD.

month.description: Textual month label (e.g. May 2026). Prefer for GROUP BY when present.

intervals.mtd: CAST(XnDt AS date) >= DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(GETDATE()), MONTH(GETDATE()), 1) AND CAST(XnDt AS date) <= CAST(GETDATE() AS date)
intervals.qtd: CAST(XnDt AS date) >= DATEFROMPARTS(CASE WHEN MONTH(GETDATE()) BETWEEN 4 AND 6 THEN YEAR(GETDATE()) WHEN MONTH(GETDATE()) BETWEEN 7 AND 9 THEN YEAR(GETDATE()) WHEN MONTH(GETDATE()) BETWEEN 10 AND 12 THEN YEAR(GETDATE()) ELSE YEAR(GETDATE())-1 END, CASE WHEN MONTH(GETDATE()) BETWEEN 4 AND 6 THEN 4 WHEN MONTH(GETDATE()) BETWEEN 7 AND 9 THEN 7 WHEN MONTH(GETDATE()) BETWEEN 10 AND 12 THEN 10 ELSE 1 END, 1) AND CAST(XnDt AS date) <= CAST(GETDATE() AS date)
intervals.ytd: CAST(XnDt AS date) >= DATEFROMPARTS(CASE WHEN MONTH(GETDATE())>=4 THEN YEAR(GETDATE()) ELSE YEAR(GETDATE())-1 END, 4, 1) AND CAST(XnDt AS date) <= CAST(GETDATE() AS date)
intervals.30d: CAST(XnDt AS date) >= DATEADD(day, -30, CAST(GETDATE() AS date))
intervals.90d: CAST(XnDt AS date) >= DATEADD(day, -90, CAST(GETDATE() AS date))
intervals.180d: CAST(XnDt AS date) >= DATEADD(month, -6, CAST(GETDATE() AS date))
intervals.today: CAST(XnDt AS date) = CAST(GETDATE() AS date)
intervals.yesterday: CAST(XnDt AS date) = DATEADD(day, -1, CAST(GETDATE() AS date))

_info: Rich business semantic layer for zRetailHQ0. Runtime merges db_tables_views_columns.json + semantic-domain-rules.json via services/dynamic-semantic-layer.js. Per-view blocks below override global semantic_mappings.

dbo.VW_MB_POWERBI_SLSXNS_REPORT.purpose: Primary sales transactions view. The single best view for all sales analysis — revenue, quantity, returns, GST. Each row is one article sold/returned on one transaction.
dbo.VW_MB_POWERBI_SLSXNS_REPORT.primaryUseCase: MTD/QTD/YTD sales, branch performance, department/category breakdown, supplier sell-through, net revenue after returns

keyColumns.XnDt: Transaction date (datetime). Always CAST to date for WHERE comparisons. Use for MTD/QTD/YTD/date range filters.
keyColumns.XnDtMonth: Pre-formatted month label (e.g. 'Apr-2026'). Use for monthly GROUP BY instead of FORMAT().
keyColumns.BranchAlias: Branch short code e.g. '01-SE', '02-MU'. Use this on all PowerBI views. NEVER use BranchId on this view.
keyColumns.DepartmentShortName: Short department name e.g. 'WOMEN', 'MENS', 'KIDS'. Primary dimension for department analysis.
keyColumns.CategoryShortName: Short category name e.g. 'SAREE', 'KURTA'. Primary dimension for category analysis.
keyColumns.SupplierName: Full supplier/vendor name. Use for supplier-wise analysis.
keyColumns.SupplierAlias: Short supplier code. Alternative to SupplierName.
keyColumns.ArticleNo: Article/style number. Use for product-level analysis.
keyColumns.Fabric: Fabric type e.g. Cotton, Silk, Georgette.
keyColumns.ItemMRP: Maximum Retail Price per unit. NOT revenue.
keyColumns.CostPrice: Purchase cost per unit. NOT revenue. Use for margin analysis.
keyColumns.SlsMrpValue: Gross MRP value of sales. NOT net revenue.
keyColumns.SlsCostValue: Cost value of goods sold. Use for profit margin.
keyColumns.SlsNetAmount: Gross net sales amount BEFORE deducting returns.
keyColumns.SlrQty: Sales return quantity. Positive number representing returns.
keyColumns.SlrNetAmount: Sales return amount. Deduct from SlsNetAmount to get net.
keyColumns.NetSlsQty: Net sales quantity = SlsQty - SlrQty. Use for unit sales.
keyColumns.NetSlsNetAmount: NET REVENUE = SlsNetAmount - SlrNetAmount. PRIMARY REVENUE METRIC. Always use this for sales revenue.
keyColumns.NetSlsCostValue: Net cost value. Use for gross profit = NetSlsNetAmount - NetSlsCostValue.
keyColumns.NetSlsMrpValue: Net MRP value. Use for discount analysis: MRP - Net = discount.
keyColumns.BillCount: Number of invoices/bills. Use for footfall and average bill value = NetSlsNetAmount/BillCount.

dbo.VwAISalesData.purpose: Core sales transaction table with invoice-level detail. Best for customer analysis, salesperson performance, invoice lookup. Each row is one item on one invoice.
dbo.VwAISalesData.primaryUseCase: Customer purchase history, salesperson ranking, invoice detail, JOIN with VwMstItems for product info, JOIN with VwAIBranch for branch names

keyColumns.InvoiceDt: Invoice/transaction date (datetime). CAST to date for comparisons.
keyColumns.InvoiceNo: Invoice number (human-readable). COUNT(DISTINCT InvoiceNo) = bill count.
keyColumns.BranchId: Numeric branch ID. JOIN VwAIBranch ON BranchId to get branch name. NEVER use BranchAlias here.
keyColumns.CustomerId: Customer identifier. JOIN VwAICustomerDetails ON CustomerId.
keyColumns.ItemId: Item/product identifier. JOIN VwMstItems ON ItemId for product details.
keyColumns.SaleAmountBeforeTax: Pre-tax sales amount. NOT the final revenue metric.
keyColumns.SaleNetAmount: NET REVENUE for this view = post-tax net amount. PRIMARY REVENUE for VwAISalesData.
keyColumns.SalesPersonId: Salesperson identifier. JOIN VwAISalesPerson ON SalesPersonId.

joinHints: JOIN dbo.VwAIBranch b ON s.BranchId = b.BranchId  -- to get BranchName/ShortName
JOIN dbo.VwMstItems i ON s.ItemId = i.ItemId  -- to get product name/category/dept
JOIN dbo.VwAICustomerDetails c ON s.CustomerId = c.CustomerId  -- for customer details
JOIN dbo.VwAISalesPerson sp ON s.SalesPersonId = sp.SalesPersonId  -- for salesperson name

dbo.VW_MB_POWERBI_SLS_REPORT.purpose: Summarised sales report with product attributes. Good for article-level analysis with supplier and branch breakdown.

keyColumns.XnMemoDate: Transaction memo date. Use for date filtering.
keyColumns.NetAmount: Net sales amount. Revenue metric for this view.

dbo.VW_MB_POWERBI_SLS_ARTICLE_REPORT.purpose: Article/product level sales report. Best for article-level sell-through analysis by category and fabric.

dbo.VW_MB_POWERBI_SLS_BILLCOUNT.purpose: Bill count / footfall per branch per day. Simplest view — use for footfall trends.

keyColumns.BranchId: Numeric branch ID. JOIN VwAIBranch for name.

neverUse: BranchAlias (not in this view — use BranchId and JOIN VwAIBranch)

dbo.VW_MB_POWERBI_SLS_DATA_WITHOUT_ITEMI.purpose: Sales transaction view with branch/customer/salesperson details but without item ID. Good for sales rep analysis and customer-level reporting without product join.

keyColumns.SalesPersonName: Name of salesperson who made the sale.

dbo.VW_MB_POWERBI_MIS_SUPPLIER_SLS_DATA.purpose: Monthly supplier-wise sales MIS report. Best for monthly supplier performance analysis.

keyColumns.NetSlsQty: Net quantity sold to end customers.

dbo.VW_MB_POWERBI_PUR_REPORT.purpose: Purchase report — what was bought from suppliers, by branch and department. Each row is one article purchased.

dbo.VW_MB_POWERBI_PURXNS_REPORT.purpose: Detailed purchase transactions including returns (PRT). Best for net purchase analysis and GST reconciliation.

keyColumns.NetPurNetAmount: Net purchase amount after returns. PRIMARY PURCHASE REVENUE METRIC.

dbo.VW_MB_POWERBI_PRT_REPORT.purpose: Purchase return transactions only. Use for return-to-supplier analysis.

dbo.VW_MB_POWERBI_PUR_QTY_WITH_COST.purpose: Compact purchase summary with quantity and cost. Best for quick purchase trend and cost analysis.

dbo.VW_MB_POWERBI_SUPPLIER_PUR_REPORT.purpose: Supplier-wise purchase detail with product attributes. Best for supplier purchase analysis with style details.

dbo.VW_MB_POWERBI_STOCK_REPORT.purpose: Current stock on hand by article, branch, category. Best for inventory analysis and stock ageing.

keyColumns.ItemId: Item ID. JOIN VwMstItems for full details.

dbo.VW_MB_POWERBI_STOCK_REPORT.commonUseCase: Stock at branch X, total stock by category, articles with zero stock, slow-moving stock (high stock low sales)

dbo.VW_MB_POWERBI_CBS_WITH_GIT.purpose: Closing Balance Stock + Goods In Transit. Complete inventory picture including goods in transit between branches.

keyColumns.GitQty: Goods In Transit quantity — received at source, not yet at destination.
keyColumns.GitCostValue: Cost value of goods in transit.
keyColumns.StockQty: Physical stock on hand at branch.
keyColumns.CbsCostValue: Closing balance stock at cost value.
keyColumns.CbsMrpValue: Closing balance stock at MRP value.

dbo.VW_MB_POWERBI_APP_REPORT.purpose: Primary AI / text-to-SQL sales fact (28-view allowlist). Approval/consignment lines — use MrpValue for revenue, AppQty for units, XnDt for dates.
dbo.VW_MB_POWERBI_APP_REPORT.primaryUseCase: MTD/QTD/YTD sales, branch/category/supplier breakdown, AI Query default target_view

keyColumns.MrpValue: PRIMARY REVENUE METRIC for AI queries. User term SaleNetAmount maps here. Use SUM(MrpValue).

dbo.VW_MB_POWERBI_APR_REPORT.purpose: Approval returns — goods returned to supplier from consignment/approval.

dbo.VW_MB_POWERBI_STI_REPORT.purpose: Stock Transfer In — goods received at target branch from source branch. Use for inter-branch transfer analysis.

dbo.VW_MB_POWERBI_STO_REPORT.purpose: Stock Transfer Out — goods dispatched from source branch to target branch.

dbo.VW_MB_POWERBI_BRANCH_LIST.purpose: Branch master list. Use for listing all branches, filtering active branches, identifying warehouses.

keyColumns.ActiveStatus: 1 = Active, 0 = Inactive. Always filter WHERE ActiveStatus=1 unless asked for all.

dbo.VW_MB_POWERBI_CATEGORY_MASTER.purpose: Category hierarchy master — Department > Category > Sub-category. Use for category drill-down or listing all categories.

dbo.VW_MB_POWERBI_PRODUCT_MASTER.purpose: Complete product master with all style attributes. Use for product catalogue analysis and attribute-based filtering.

dbo.VW_MB_POWERBI_VENDOR_MASTER.purpose: Vendor/supplier master with complete details including GST, credit terms, MSME status.

dbo.VwAIBranch.purpose: Branch master. Use for JOIN to get branch names from BranchId in VwAISalesData.

keyColumns.BranchId: Numeric branch ID — use to JOIN with VwAISalesData.

joinHints: JOIN dbo.VwAIBranch b ON s.BranchId = b.BranchId  -- always use this when showing branch names with VwAISalesData

dbo.VwAICustomerDetails.purpose: Customer master with contact details, loyalty group, birthday/anniversary. Join with VwAISalesData for customer purchase analysis.

keyColumns.CustomerGroupName: Loyalty/customer group e.g. Silver, Gold, Platinum.
keyColumns.BirthdayDt: Birthday. For birthday month: MONTH(BirthdayDt)=MONTH(GETDATE()). NEVER filter by year.
keyColumns.AnniversaryDt: Wedding anniversary. Same month-only filter rule as birthday.
keyColumns.CreatedOn: Customer registration date. Use for new customer acquisition analysis.

neverUse: YEAR(BirthdayDt) = YEAR(GETDATE()) — always 0 rows since birthday year is birth year, not current year

dbo.VwAISalesPerson.purpose: Salesperson master. JOIN with VwAISalesData for salesperson performance ranking.

dbo.VwAIStockData.purpose: Current stock snapshot — simplest stock view. One row per item per branch.

keyColumns.ItemId: Item ID — JOIN VwMstItems for product details.
keyColumns.BranchId: Branch ID — JOIN VwAIBranch for branch name.

dbo.VwAISupplier.purpose: Supplier master for AI views. JOIN with VwAISalesData not directly possible — use VwMstItems.PurPartyId.

dbo.VwMstItems.purpose: Complete item/product master. JOIN with VwAISalesData ON ItemId for product-level sales analysis. Contains all product attributes.
